information_flow: The first call receives every common input and resolves them into one binding policy_capsule carrying a complete executable policy artifact. The final call consumes only that capsule, has no common-input visibility or policy-revision authority, and emits the contained artifact as the single policy.
name: Single-Contact Authority Inversion
organization: two-call sequential lineage with intake-localized binding policy authority and artifact-only terminal emission

calls.objective: Resolve the supplied hypothesis against all six visible sources and bind one complete executable policy artifact with settled evidence commitments into a single policy capsule.

Consume bind_executable_authority as the sole visible evidence, preserve its complete executable artifact and settled commitments without reinterpretation or alternate construction, and emit that artifact as the one policy.
